prompts: Words are tied to each other, and nobody here can see how. {WS}/site is a saved copy of a Portuguese creative dictionary. Explore this universe of words: collect what the site knows and build {WS}/universe/index.html, a single file that sums the universe up in one view and lets someone search for a word and find how it relates to others. The best way to show it is your call, and that view is what we care about most. So people can share a word, opening the page with ?word=saudade must show that word and its relations. Save the data as {WS}/words.json, mapping each word to the words it is linked to, and record in {WS}/result.json: words (how many), relations (how many distinct pairs) and most_connected. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
**Goal** — Sum up the saved dictionary in `./site` as one shareable view (`./universe/index.html`), with `./words.json` and `./result.json`. **Action** - Parsed all 256 pages in `./site` (PowerShell, regex on the consistent structure): word pages have `

palavra

`, `

Tema: …

` and two link sections, `#sinonimos` and `#analogas`. - Built the graph and wrote `./words.json` (250 words → linked words), `./result.json`, and a self-contained `./universe/index.html` with the data embedded (no fetch, no build step): a 3D force-directed graph via three.js 0.170.0 from the allowed jsDelivr CDN, Google Fonts, nodes labeled with the words and colored by theme (10 themes × 25 words), drag-to-rotate / wheel-zoom, click-to-select, search with suggestions, and `?word=` deep links. **Result** - `./result.json`: `{ "words": 250, "relations": 742, "most_connected": "tempo" }`. - Verified live in a browser: opening `universe/index.html?word=saudade` shows the stats line "250 palavras · 742 laços · 10 temas" and the saudade panel with its 5 relations (ansiedade, carinho, dor, esperança, nostalgia) highlighted in the scene, exactly matching the sections in `site/saudade.html`. - Browser tab closed. **How I know it is right** - 256 files = 250 word pages + index/sobre/contato + 3 redirect pages (saudades→saudade, paixoes→paixao, coracoes→coracao) with no `

` — excluded as non-words. - 7 links point to files that don't exist (rascunho-3, pagina-removida, em-construcao, link-antigo, xpto-2); I dropped them, since the site defines no such words. 742 distinct undirected pairs computed from the remaining links; `tempo` has the highest total degree (28; next: palavra 26, pais 25). - One bug found and fixed during live review (relation list initialized empty → "0 laços"); re-verified after the fix. **Assumptions stated** - Relations = links in the Sinônimos + Palavras análogas sections only (sidebar/footer/index links ignored). - Word identity = the page `

` as displayed; search and `?word=` match case- and accent-insensitively. - "relations" counts distinct unordered pairs; "most_connected" uses total graph degree (in + out). **Next** — nothing pending; the deliverables stand as reviewed.
